public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPT-5 was both late and short of expectations.

statement.excerpt: (Altman got famous hinting at the supposed miracles of GPT-5; by any reasonable measure it was both late and short of expectations.)
statement.document_title: The rapid rise and slow decline of Sam Altman

from_speaker: both late and short of expectations
Altman got famous hinting at the supposed miracles
our_interpretation: Late means released later than OpenAI's earlier public plans, including approximate timelines.
Short of expectations means a substantial shortfall against capabilities publicly anticipated before release. Disappointment among selected users alone does not establish that broader conclusion.
The target is the original GPT-5 release and its reception during 2025, not subsequent GPT-5 versions.
Read 'by any reasonable measure' as an emphatic claim of broadly disappointing delivery, rather than requiring literal unanimity.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes both a postponed public release plan and a substantial gap between identifiable pre-release capability expectations and delivered performance.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that GPT-5 met the relevant earlier release plan, or that its delivered capabilities broadly met the identifiable expectations used for comparison.
